honest_c3: C3.1: BG-JE source materials are anima-domain (NEXUS-UBM/우주뇌지도/identity) — stitched multi-turn samples may have topic-incoherent turn flow within same persona bucket (random pair sampling, not topic-conditioned).
C3.2: KoAlpaca-v1.1a is generic Korean Q&A (Naver kin), NOT anima-domain — may dilute anima-specific chat signal; mixing trade-off vs Korean fluency gain.
C3.3: multi-turn assembly = synthetic stitching, NOT real conversational data — user's 다음 turn은 prior turn에 'follow up'하지 않음 (independent QA stitched).

C3.4: Hangul ratio per-sample filter 0.45+ may discard valid mixed-language blocks (English code/keyword inclusions). global hangul_ratio target 0.55 favors generic KO; anima domain corpus often contains EN technical terms.
C3.5: <turn>...</turn> wrapper is anima-internal convention — model must learn this special token at training time; no pre-training prior.
C3.6: Length filter 80-1500 bytes ≈ 100-500 token range under byte-tokenizer; BPE/SP tokenizer may shift effective token count (chars → 0.3-0.5× tokens).

C3.7: Multi-turn ratio is structure-only, NOT semantic continuity — V5.8 eval on this corpus may show high template-pass but low actual conversation coherence (Lesson Q decoder-only fix 不可 still applies if architecture is the bottleneck).
C3.8: KoAlpaca download via streaming (no local cache) — re-runs require network; if HF Hub down, KoAlpaca samples = 0 (BG-JE-only fallback).
